activities.title: Things to do in Tokyo
chunks:
A · My favorite tea house
The tea house is in a beautiful garden. We don't wear shoes in the tea house. We leave our shoes outside. We sit on the floor. It's a custom (מנהג) in Japan. We can see how they make the tea. Their green tea is the best.

B · A cool ice cream store
I love this ice cream store. The ice cream looks like animals. They have rabbits, chickens, dogs and bears. I always order the rabbit ice cream. You can pick anything you want.

C · A baseball (כדור בסיס) game
Baseball is a popular sport in Japan. The games are fun. People sing songs when their team hits the ball. They wear shirts and hats from their favorite team. I have a hat from a team called the Lions. My sister has hats from every baseball team in Japan.

D · A ninja village
The ninja village is great. You wear ninja clothes and climb walls like a ninja. There's also a ninja house. It's fun to walk in the house and find special rooms. I think ninjas are exciting (מלהיבים)! They are strong. They aren't afraid of anything.
We need to ride a train to the ninja village. It isn't in Tokyo. But the train is fun too.

activities.title: Snow Monkeys
chunks:
A · What are snow monkeys?
Snow monkeys are special monkeys in Japan. They are brown and gray, and they have pink faces. They have lots of fur (פרווה) to keep them warm. They are the only monkeys in the world that can live in the cold. That's the reason they are called snow monkeys.
There are about one hundred thousand (100,000) snow monkeys in Japan. Many snow monkeys live in the snowy mountains. But not all of them. Some snow monkeys live in warm forests.
Snow monkeys eat plants and fruit. In the snowy mountains, it's hard to find food in the winter. Sometimes the monkeys come into towns and take food from people.
Snow monkeys usually sleep in trees, but they also sleep on the ground. They don't lie down when they sleep. They sit. In the winter, several snow monkeys sleep together to keep warm.

B · Why are snow monkeys famous?
Many years ago, some snow monkeys saw people sitting in hot pools in the snowy mountains. The monkeys decided to copy (להעתיק) the people. They climbed into the hot pools and enjoyed the warm water. The snow monkeys liked the pools. They returned again and again. Today, the snow monkeys still go to the hot pools to keep warm in the winter. In the spring, summer and autumn, they go in the hot pools to swim, play and rest. They are famous because people like to watch them in the pools.
